Class CheckoutDialog.OrderService

java.lang.Object
CheckoutDialog.OrderService
Enclosing class:
CheckoutDialog
private static final class CheckoutDialog.OrderService extends Object
Saves a completed Cashier order: the order, its items and options, and the inventory it used, in one transaction

Cole Baldwind
